changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE estate_letter_approvals ADD COLUMN template_source varchar(10), ADD COLUMN template_version integer, ADD CONSTRAINT chk_estate_letter_approvals_template_source CHECK (template_source IS NULL OR template_source IN ('default', 'company', 'branch')); COMMENT ON COLUMN estate_letter_approvals.template_source IS 'Whose letter template the approved letter used: HomeTrue''s default wording, the company''s or the branch''s. Null on approvals recorded before 094.';
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE estate_letter_approvals DROP CONSTRAINT chk_estate_letter_approvals_template_source, DROP COLUMN template_version, DROP COLUMN template_source;
